Boundary: Focuses strictly on engineering infrastructure stabilization and post-mortems rather than commercial SLA retention discussions or routine connector latency.

Boundary: Focuses on capability education and roadmap requests for compliance features rather than commercial contract negotiations or internal corporate audits.
- Identity Authentication and Directory Provisioning: Calls concerning directory synchronization queues, SAML SSO regressions, session timeouts, and SCIM/IAM policy provisioning. Boundary: Centers strictly on access control and directory sync troubleshooting rather than alert rule tuning or backup job infrastructure.
- Backup Performance and Scalability: Calls addressing degraded backup throughput, snapshot deduplication bottlenecks, connector permission failures, and restore limitations. Boundary: Focuses on initial pre-production deployment architecture and milestones rather than post-launch break-fix troubleshooting or renewal discussions.
- Detection Alert Tuning and Optimization: Calls assisting customers with configuring behavioral baselines, suppressing false-positive spikes, and tuning detection thresholds to reduce SOC fatigue. - Aegis Detect

- Aegis Protect
- Aegis Identity
- Platform/General (when no single product dominates)
